purpose: Protected-mode lifetime trace for pooled 01F7:6328 children created by the player contact probe.

method.focus: 01F7:6328 pooled callback; object focus without a fixed offset
method.trigger: one live 01F7:3FF8 callback with MAP cell (8,25) temporarily changed to tile 5
method.patch_scope: the MAP patch was restored at the player callback near return before lifetime sampling
method.scheduler_capture: both 0x7566 and 0x7766 banks at each focused callback

observations.countdown: Each callback decrements +0x32; a negative result reloads +0x32=8 and increments +0x2e.
observations.scheduler: The two live children are published in the alternating scheduler banks; dispatch order can interleave them, but neither slot is cleared before +0x2e reaches 4.
observations.terminal_release: The callback writes +0x18=0 when +0x2e becomes 4; the pool slot is then eligible for reuse.
observations.child_side_effect: The focused child reaches 01F7:16CE on its periodic state transition; the child itself performs no solid-collision probe or direct player/global movement write.

confirmed: The 01F7:6328 pooled callback lifetime and terminal callback-clear condition match the protected-mode static body.
Object focus must treat 01F7:6328 as a pooled callback distinct from the direct player contact-probe callsite.
Scheduler-bank alternation changes observation order but not the callback state machine.
does_not_prove: retail descriptor classification or one-way semantics
whether the 01F7:16CE MAP rewrite can later change a solid descriptor in normal gameplay
lifetime behavior of unrelated 0E06-selected callback families
